Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Many thanks for your letter, I send the [agreement](../others.html#160), with which I am quite satisfied. I also send by train four nos of the [Christian Remembrancer](../others.html#59) containing four papers
Folk Lore & Old Stories
[Lord Seaton & his Regiment](../books.html#66)
[The La Ferronays family](../books.html#64)
[Eugenie de Guérin](../books.html#50)
There are also- only I have not disinterred them [Miss Sewell’s Principles of Education](../books.html#302) and the [Life of Bishop Mackenzie](../books.html#52) but these will be enough for you to see whether they are available.[^1]
The Ghosts as you see are in Folk Lore.

If advisable I could expand that a good deal - and make a little volume of it.
I have not signed the agreement as I should like you to fill it up first lest I should do it incorrectly

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY wanted Macmillans to publish a volume of her unpublished non-fiction articles, but the idea never came to anything.
